final: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rfistat),''),'No Status') AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS base FROM signals), k AS (SELECT g.status, g.avg_mod, b.base FROM g, b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.base) SELECT status, avg_mod, avg_mod - base AS above_baseline, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k
